# Location Map

```{r loading stuff, include = FALSE}
fish <- read_csv("combinedFish.csv")
invert <- read_csv("combinedInvert.csv")

fishmap <- fish |>
  dplyr::select(latitude, longitude, location)

invertmap <- invert |>
  dplyr::select(latitude, longitude, location)

bothmap <- rbind(fishmap, invertmap)

uniquemap <- bothmap |>
  dplyr::select(latitude, longitude, location) |>
  distinct()

fishLong <- read_csv("combinedLongFish.csv")
invertLong <- read_csv("combinedLongInvert.csv")

wrasseFuci <- fishLong |>
  filter(species == "Notolabrus fucicola")
abaloneRubr <- invertLong |>
  filter(species == "Haliotis rubra")
bastardFors <- fishLong |>
  filter(species == "Latridopsis forsteri")
wrasseTetr <- fishLong |>
  filter(species == "Notolabrus tetricus")
herringCyan <- fishLong |>
  filter(species == "Olisthops cyanomelas")
urchinEryt <- invertLong |>
  filter(species == "Heliocidaris erythrogramma")
snailUndu <- invertLong |>
  filter(species == "Turbo undulatus")
lobsterEdwa <- invertLong |>
  filter(species == "Jasus edwardsii")

pwrasse <- readRDS("modelPW.rds")
babalone <- readRDS("modelBA.rds")
trumpeter <- readRDS("modelBT.rds")
bwrasse <- readRDS("modelBW.rds")
herring <- readRDS("modelHC.rds")
urchin <- readRDS("modelSU.rds")
snail <- readRDS("modelTS.rds")
lobster <- readRDS("modelRL.rds")
```

```{r bioregion from my data read in, include = FALSE}
bioregions <- read_sf("Bioregions_shapefile/Bioregions.shp")
```


```{r bioregion read in, include = FALSE}
#these are in VicGrid on GDA94 projections
bioregions <- read_sf("Bioregions_shapefile/Bioregions.shp")

bioregions <- bioregions |>
  filter(MESO_NAME %in% c("Boags", "Bruny", "Davey", "Flinders", "Franklin", "Freycinet", "Otway", "Twofold Shelf", "Victorian Embayments", "Central Victoria", "Central Bass Strait"))
```

```{r australia basemap, include = FALSE}
# get australia basemap
australia <- ne_states(country = "australia", returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r color palette stuff, include = FALSE}
# color palette stuff
d3_cols <- pal_d3(palette = "category20")(length(unique(bioregions$MESO_NAME)))

# create named vector of colours
bioregion_levels <- levels(factor(bioregions$MESO_NAME))
names(d3_cols) <- bioregion_levels

# swap Victorian Embayments and Central Bass Strait
vic_col <- d3_cols["Victorian Embayments"]
cbs_col <- d3_cols["Central Bass Strait"]
d3_cols["Victorian Embayments"] <- cbs_col
d3_cols["Central Bass Strait"] <- vic_col

# see which colour maps to which bioregion
data.frame(
  bioregion = levels(factor(bioregions$MESO_NAME)),
  colour = d3_cols
)
```

```{r bioregion sf stuff, include = FALSE}
# convert polygons to lines
bioregions_lines <- st_cast(bioregions, "MULTILINESTRING")

bioregions_boundary <- st_boundary(bioregions)
```


```{r region map, echo = FALSE}
# plot
ggplot() +
  # basemap
  geom_sf(data = australia, fill = "lightgrey", color = "white") +
  # draw Bass Strait first (behind)
  geom_sf(data = bioregions |> filter(MESO_NAME == "Central Bass Strait"), 
          aes(color = MESO_NAME, fill = MESO_NAME),
          alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  # draw all other bioregions on top
  geom_sf(data = bioregions |> filter(MESO_NAME != "Central Bass Strait"), 
          aes(color = MESO_NAME, fill = MESO_NAME),
          alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = d3_cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = d3_cols) +
  guides(fill = "none",
       color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = d3_cols,
                                                 alpha = 1,
                                                 linewidth = 0))) + # hides fill legend, keeps color legend but fills in the boxes
  # survey points
  geom_point(data = uniquemap,
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),
             color = "black", size = 1) +
  # zoom to vic/tas
  coord_sf(xlim = c(142.5, 150), ylim = c(-44, -37.5)) +
  #scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Survey locations and bioregions",
       x = "Longitude",
       y = "Latitude",
       color = "Bioregion")
```

```{r}
# create the main map (your existing code)
main_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = australia, fill = "lightgrey", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = bioregions |> filter(MESO_NAME == "Central Bass Strait"), 
          aes(color = MESO_NAME, fill = MESO_NAME),
          alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = bioregions |> filter(MESO_NAME != "Central Bass Strait"), 
          aes(color = MESO_NAME, fill = MESO_NAME),
          alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = d3_cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = d3_cols) +
  guides(fill = "none",
         color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = d3_cols,
                                                   alpha = 1,
                                                   linewidth = 0))) +
  
  geom_point(data = uniquemap,
             aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),
             color = "black", size = 1.15) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(141.5, 150), ylim = c(-44, -35.75)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Survey locations and bioregions",
       x = "Longitude",
       y = "Latitude",
       color = "Bioregion")

# create the inset map of all australia
# with a rectangle showing the study area
inset_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = australia, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  # add rectangle showing study area extent
  annotate("rect", 
           xmin = 140, xmax = 150, 
           ymin = -44, ymax = -35,
           fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(113, 154), ylim = c(-44, -10)) +
  theme_void()  # no axes or labels for inset

# convert inset to grob
inset_grob <- ggplotGrob(inset_map)

# add inset to main map
inset_map <- main_map +
  annotation_custom(
    grob = inset_grob,
    xmin = 141,  # position of inset (in map coordinates)
    xmax = 145,
    ymin = -38,
    ymax = -35.5
  )

inset_map
```

```{r}
ggsave(plot = inset_map, "inset_map.pdf")
```


# Gam.hp

```{r hp loading, include = FALSE}
pwrassehp <- readRDS("hp_purplewrasse.rds")
bwrassehp <- readRDS("hp_bluethroatwrasse.rds")
hcalehp <- readRDS("hp_herringcale.rds")
rlobsterhp <- readRDS("hp_rocklobster.rds")
tsnailhp <- readRDS("hp_turbosnail.rds")
surchinhp <- readRDS("hp_shortspinedurchin.rds")
babalonehp <- readRDS("hp_blacklipabalone.rds")
```

```{r hp prep, include = FALSE}
hp_combined <- bind_rows(
  list(
  "Purple Wrasse" = pwrassehp,
  "Bluethroat Wrasse" = bwrassehp,
  "Herring Cale" = hcalehp,
  "Rock Lobster" = rlobsterhp,
  "Turbo Snail" = tsnailhp,
  "Shortspined Urchin" = surchinhp,
  "Blacklip Abalone" = babalonehp
  ),
  .id = 'species'
)
```


```{r hp by stressor, echo = FALSE}
nobioregion <- hp_combined |>
  filter(variable != "bioregion")

colorscheme <- c("#CC79A7", "#56B4E9", "#E69F00", "#009E73", "#D55E00", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#000000")
  
# plot
hp_fig_bioregion <- ggplot(hp_combined, aes(x = reorder(variable, value), y = value, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Purple Wrasse" = "#CC79A7",
    "Bluethroat Wrasse" = "#56B4E9",
    "Herring Cale" = "#009E73",
    "Bastard Trumpeter" = "#E69F00",
    "Rock Lobster" = "#D55E00",
    "Turbo Snail" = "#F0E442",
    "Shortspined Urchin" = "#0072B2",
    "Blacklip Abalone" = "#000000"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Predictor", 
       y = "Individual contribution (%)", 
       fill = "Species")

hp_fig_bioregion
```

```{r adding scientific name column, include = FALSE}
hp_combined <- hp_combined |>
    mutate(species = case_when(
    species == "Blacklip Abalone" ~ "H. rubra",
    species == "Purple Wrasse" ~ "N. fucicola",
    species == "Bluethroat Wrasse" ~ "N. tetricus",
    species == "Herring Cale" ~ "O. cyanomelas",
    species == "Rock Lobster" ~ "J. edwardsii",
    species == "Shortspined Urchin" ~ "H. erythrogramma",
    species == "Turbo Snail" ~ "T. undulatus",
    TRUE ~ species  # keeps all other location names as they are
  ))

```

```{r}
hp_combined$type <- hp_combined$species

hp_combined <- hp_combined |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    type == "H. rubra" ~ "Invertebrates",
    type == "N. fucicola" ~ "Fishes",
    type == "N. tetricus" ~ "Fishes",
    type == "O. cyanomelas" ~ "Fishes",
    type == "J. edwardsii" ~ "Invertebrates",
    type == "H. erythrogramma" ~ "Invertebrates",
    type == "T. undulatus" ~ "Invertebrates"))
```

```{r}
hp_combined <- hp_combined |>
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "apparent_fishing_hours" ~ "Commercial Fishing",
    variable == "total_mhw_intensity" ~ "Annual MHW Intensity",
    variable == "mhw_days" ~ "Annual MHW Days",
    variable == "chlor_a" ~ "Chlorophyll a Concentration",
    variable == "year" ~ "Survey Year",
    variable == "depth" ~ "Survey Depth",
    variable == "ship_count" ~ "Shipping",
    variable == "log_population" ~ "Population",
    variable == "month" ~ "Survey Month",
    variable == "current_intensity_score" ~ "Current Change Intensity",
    variable == "protection" ~ "Protection Status",
    variable == "bioregion" ~ "Bioregion"
  ))
```

```{r}

  group_by(variable) |>
```

```{r}
hp_ranked <- hp_combined |>
  group_by(species) |>
  mutate(rank = rank(-value, ties.method = "min")) |>  # negative so largest gets rank 1
  ungroup()

hp_ranked$rank <- as.factor(hp_ranked$rank)

ggplot(hp_ranked, aes(x = variable, fill = rank)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic")) +
  labs(x = "Species", 
       y = "Individual contribution (%)",
       title = "Individual Model Contributions by Species",
       fill = "Covairate")
```



## Smooths

### Current intensity change

```{r currents setup, include = FALSE}
currentPWrasse <- smooth_estimates(pwrasse, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
currentBWrasse <- smooth_estimates(bwrasse, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
currentHerring <- smooth_estimates(herring, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
currentTrumpeter <- smooth_estimates(trumpeter, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
currentLobster <- smooth_estimates(lobster, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
currentUrchin <- smooth_estimates(urchin, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
currentBabalone <- smooth_estimates(babalone, select = "s(current_intensity_score)")
```

```{r currents figs, echo = FALSE}
CPW <- currentPWrasse |>
  add_confint() |>
  ggplot(aes(y = .estimate, x = current_intensity_score)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#CC79A7") +
  geom_line(color = "#CC79A7", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_rug(data = wrasseFuci,  # use your actual data
           aes(x = current_intensity_score),
           inherit.aes = FALSE, #don't inherit y value from earlier ggplot aes call
           alpha = 0.3, sides = "b") +
  labs(
    y = "Partial Effect",
    x = "Current Intensity Score",
    title = expression(italic("N. fucicola") ~ "- Purple Wrasse")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.95)),
        axis.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85)))  # 80% of default size

CBW <- currentBWrasse |>

CHC <- currentHerring |>
```

```{r shipping figs, echo = FALSE}
    title = expression(italic("T. undulatus") ~ "- Turban Snail")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.95)),
        axis.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85)))

SSU <- shipUrchin |>
  add_confint() |>
  ggplot(aes(y = .estimate, x = ship_count)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#0072B2") +
  geom_line(color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_rug(data = urchinEryt,  # use your actual data
           aes(x = ship_count),
           inherit.aes = FALSE, #don't inherit y value from earlier ggplot aes call
           alpha = 0.3, sides = "b") +
  labs(
    y = "Partial Effect",
    x = "Number of Ships (Monthly Total)",
    title = expression(italic("H. erythrogramma") ~ "- Shortspined Urchin")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.95)),
        axis.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85)))

SBA <- shipBabalone |>
  add_confint() |>
  ggplot(aes(y = .estimate, x = ship_count)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower_ci, ymax = .upper_ci),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#000000") +
  geom_line(color = "#000000", linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_rug(data = abaloneRubr,  # use your actual data
           aes(x = ship_count),
           inherit.aes = FALSE, #don't inherit y value from earlier ggplot aes call
           alpha = 0.3, sides = "b") +
  labs(
    y = "Partial Effect",
    x = "Number of Ships (Monthly Total)",
    title = expression(italic("H. rubra") ~ "- Blacklip Abalone")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.95)),
        axis.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85)))

ship1 <- (SBW + SHC) / (SRL + STS) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Partial Effects: Shipping Pressure",
                  tag_levels = "A")

ship2 <- (SSU + SBA) / (plot_spacer()) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("E", "F")))

ship1
ship2

#ggsave(plot = ship2, "fig_ship2_update.pdf")
```

### Population

```{r pop setup, include = FALSE}
popBWrasse <- smooth_estimates(bwrasse, select = "s(log_population)")
popHerring <- smooth_estimates(herring, select = "s(log_population)")
popLobster <- smooth_estimates(lobster, select = "s(log_population)")
popSnail <- smooth_estimates(snail, select = "s(log_population)")

popBabalone <- smooth_estimates(babalone, select = "s(log_population)")
```
